newsitem.title: UK: Argentina $750 mln 10-yr bond due Tuesday - traders.
newsitem.headline: Argentina $750 mln 10-yr bond due Tuesday - traders.

text.p: Argentina will launch its planned $750 million 10-year global bond on Tuesday, dealers said.

The bond is expected to be priced 435-450 basis points over the 10-year U.S. Treasury note, although some predicted a tighter 410-425 b.p. range. Goldman Sachs and Salomon Brothers will lead manage the transaction.
The country last tapped the dollar sector in early August with a $500 million three-year FRN paying of 270 b.p. over LIBOR.
It was the first bond since Domingo Cavallo was ousted as economy minister on July 26.
Argentina is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service and BB- by Standard & Poor's Corp.
